<?php
// E2E probe (test only): a stand-in for the parts of WooCommerce Subscriptions that the gateway calls, plus a scenario suite.
// Gateway HTTP is short-circuited and every request is recorded (secrets are never recorded). Nothing leaves the machine.
if ( isset( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) && 'suite' === $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) {
	// Must exist before plugins_loaded so the gateway wires its renewal hook.
	if ( ! class_exists( 'WC_Subscriptions' ) ) { class WC_Subscriptions {} }
}

add_action( 'wp_loaded', function () {
	if ( empty( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) || 'suite' !== $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) { return; }
	header( 'Content-Type: application/json' );
	if ( function_exists( 'wc_load_cart' ) && null === WC()->session ) { wc_load_cart(); }

	$G = array( 'req' => array(), 'subs_of_order' => array(), 'subs_of_renewal' => array(), 'no_vault' => false, 'n' => 0 );
	$GLOBALS['cz_e2e'] = &$G;

	// ---- a stand-in subscription object (a WC_Order that knows its parent order) ----
	if ( ! class_exists( 'CZ_E2E_Subscription' ) ) {
		class CZ_E2E_Subscription extends WC_Order {
			public function get_parent() { $pid = (int) $this->get_meta( '_e2e_parent_id' ); return $pid ? wc_get_order( $pid ) : false; }
		}
	}
	$mk_sub = function ( $parent ) use ( &$G ) {
		$s = new CZ_E2E_Subscription();
		$s->set_payment_method( 'cardz3n_gateway' );
		$s->update_meta_data( '_e2e_parent_id', $parent->get_id() );
		$s->save();
		$G['subs_of_order'][ $parent->get_id() ][ $s->get_id() ] = $s->get_id(); $G['sub_ids'][ $s->get_id() ] = true;
		return new CZ_E2E_Subscription( $s->get_id() );
	};
	$load_subs = function ( $ids ) { $o = array(); foreach ( (array) $ids as $id ) { $o[ $id ] = new CZ_E2E_Subscription( $id ); } return $o; };
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wcs_order_contains_subscription' ) ) {
		function wcs_order_contains_subscription( $order, $types = null ) { return ! empty( $GLOBALS['cz_e2e']['subs_of_order'][ is_object( $order ) ? $order->get_id() : (int) $order ] ); }
		function wcs_get_subscriptions_for_order( $order, $args = array() ) { $id = is_object( $order ) ? $order->get_id() : (int) $order; $o = array(); foreach ( (array) ( $GLOBALS['cz_e2e']['subs_of_order'][ $id ] ?? array() ) as $sid ) { $o[ $sid ] = new CZ_E2E_Subscription( $sid ); } return $o; }
		function wcs_get_subscriptions_for_renewal_order( $order ) { $id = is_object( $order ) ? $order->get_id() : (int) $order; $o = array(); foreach ( (array) ( $GLOBALS['cz_e2e']['subs_of_renewal'][ $id ] ?? array() ) as $sid ) { $o[ $sid ] = new CZ_E2E_Subscription( $sid ); } return $o; }
		function wcs_is_subscription( $x ) { $id = is_object( $x ) ? $x->get_id() : (int) $x; return ! empty( $GLOBALS['cz_e2e']['sub_ids'][ $id ] ); }
	}
	$mk_renewal = function ( $sub, $currency = 'USD' ) use ( &$G ) {
		$r = wc_create_order();
		$r->set_payment_method( 'cardz3n_gateway' );
		$r->set_currency( $currency );
		$r->set_total( '5.00' );
		$r->set_billing_email( 'e2e@example.test' );
		$r->save();
		$G['subs_of_renewal'][ $r->get_id() ][ $sub->get_id() ] = $sub->get_id();
		return $r;
	};

	// ---- the gateway's HTTP, recorded and answered ----
	add_filter( 'pre_http_request', function ( $pre, $args, $url ) use ( &$G ) {
		if ( false === strpos( (string) $url, 'transactiongateway' ) ) { return $pre; }
		parse_str( (string) $args['body'], $b );
		$keep = array( 'type', 'amount', 'currency', 'customer_vault', 'customer_vault_id', 'initiated_by', 'stored_credential_indicator', 'initial_transaction_id', 'billing_method', 'orderid', 'payment', 'transactionid' );
		$rec  = array();
		foreach ( $keep as $k ) { if ( isset( $b[ $k ] ) ) { $rec[ $k ] = $b[ $k ]; } }
		$rec['has_token'] = isset( $b['payment_token'] );
		$G['req'][] = $rec;
		++$G['n'];
		$type = $b['type'] ?? '';
		$body = 'response=1&responsetext=SUCCESS&authcode=A1&transactionid=TX-' . $G['n'];
		if ( 'sale' === $type && ! empty( $b['customer_vault_id'] ) && (float) ( $b['amount'] ?? 0 ) < 1 ) { $body = 'response=2&responsetext=DECLINE&transactionid=TX-' . $G['n']; }
		if ( 'tok-decline' === ( $b['payment_token'] ?? '' ) ) { $body = 'response=2&responsetext=DECLINE&transactionid=TX-' . $G['n']; }
		if ( in_array( $type, array( 'sale', 'validate' ), true ) && ! empty( $b['payment_token'] ) && 'tok-decline' !== $b['payment_token'] && ( $b['customer_vault'] ?? '' ) === 'add_customer' && ! $G['no_vault'] ) { $body .= '&customer_vault_id=V-' . $G['n'] . '&cc_number=4xxxxxxxxxxx1111&cc_exp=1230&cc_type=visa'; }
		return array( 'headers' => array(), 'body' => $body, 'response' => array( 'code' => 200, 'message' => 'OK' ), 'cookies' => array(), 'filename' => null );
	}, 10, 3 );

	$gw = WC()->payment_gateways()->payment_gateways()['cardz3n_gateway'];
	$out = array();
	$run = function ( $label, $fn ) use ( &$G, &$out ) {
		$G['req'] = array();
		$res      = $fn();
		$out[ $label ] = array_merge( array( 'requests' => $G['req'] ), (array) $res );
	};
	$order = function ( $total = '5.00', $currency = 'USD' ) {
		$o = wc_create_order();
		$o->set_payment_method( 'cardz3n_gateway' );
		$o->set_currency( $currency );
		$o->set_total( $total );
		$o->set_billing_email( 'e2e@example.test' );
		$o->save();
		return $o;
	};
	$post = function ( $src = 'card', $tok = 'tok-e2e' ) { $_POST = array( 'cardz3n_payment_token' => $tok, 'cardz3n_token_type' => $src, 'cardz3n_payment_source' => $src ); };
	$meta = function ( $o ) { $o = wc_get_order( $o->get_id() ); return array( 'vault' => (string) $o->get_meta( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id' ), 'initial' => (string) $o->get_meta( '_cardz3n_initial_txn_id' ) ); };
	$hook = 'woocommerce_scheduled_subscription_payment_cardz3n_gateway';


	// Each scenario runs inside try/catch so a fatal on one branch (for example a missing method on main) shows up as data.
	$run = function ( $label, $fn ) use ( &$G, &$out ) {
		$G['req'] = array();
		try { $res = $fn(); } catch ( \Throwable $e ) { $res = array( 'error' => get_class( $e ) . ': ' . $e->getMessage() ); }
		$out[ $label ] = array_merge( array( 'requests' => $G['req'] ), (array) $res );
	};
	$uid = wp_insert_user( array( 'user_login' => 'e2e_cust_' . wp_generate_password( 6, false ), 'user_pass' => wp_generate_password(), 'user_email' => 'cust' . wp_rand() . '@example.test' ) );
	$other_uid = wp_insert_user( array( 'user_login' => 'e2e_other_' . wp_generate_password( 6, false ), 'user_pass' => wp_generate_password(), 'user_email' => 'other' . wp_rand() . '@example.test' ) );
	wp_set_current_user( $uid );
	$gid = 'cardz3n_gateway';
	// A subscription owned by $uid, created from a first order that holds the old card (V-OLD / TX-OLD); the total is 5.00.
	$mk_owned = function ( $customer = null ) use ( $order, $mk_sub, $uid ) {
		$p = $order( '5.00' );
		$p->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id', 'V-OLD' ); $p->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_initial_txn_id', 'TX-OLD' ); $p->save();
		$s = $mk_sub( $p );
		$s->set_customer_id( null === $customer ? $uid : $customer );
		$s->set_total( '5.00' );
		$s->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id', 'V-OLD' ); $s->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_initial_txn_id', 'TX-OLD' );
		$s->save();
		return array( $p, new CZ_E2E_Subscription( $s->get_id() ) );
	};
	$ntok = function () use ( $uid, $gid ) { return count( \WC_Payment_Tokens::get_customer_tokens( $uid, $gid ) ); };

	// D1) The customer changes the method of one subscription to a NEW card.
	$run( 'change_new_card', function () use ( $gw, $mk_owned, $mk_renewal, $post, $meta, $hook, $ntok, &$G ) {
		list( $p, $s ) = $mk_owned();
		list( $p2, $s2 ) = $mk_owned();        // another subscription of the same customer: must stay untouched.
		$before_tokens = $ntok();
		$post();
		$r  = $gw->process_payment( $s->get_id() );
		$req = $G['req'];
		$res = array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'redirect' => $r['redirect'] ?? '', 'view_url' => ( new CZ_E2E_Subscription( $s->get_id() ) )->get_view_order_url(), 'sub' => $meta( $s ), 'parent' => $meta( $p ), 'other_sub' => $meta( $s2 ), 'tokens_added' => $ntok() - $before_tokens, 'status' => wc_get_order( $s->get_id() )->get_status() );
		$G['req'] = array();
		$ren = $mk_renewal( $s ); do_action( $hook, 5.00, $ren );
		$res['signup_requests'] = $req;
		$res['renewal_requests'] = $G['req'];
		return $res;
	} );
	// D2) The new card is declined: the old card stays.
	$run( 'change_declined', function () use ( $gw, $mk_owned, $post, $meta, $ntok ) {
		list( $p, $s ) = $mk_owned();
		$before_tokens = $ntok();
		$post( 'card', 'tok-decline' );
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $s->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'sub' => $meta( $s ), 'tokens_added' => $ntok() - $before_tokens );
	} );
	// D3) The customer picks a saved card: no gateway request at all.
	$run( 'change_saved_card', function () use ( $gw, $mk_owned, $meta, $uid, $gid ) {
		list( $p, $s ) = $mk_owned();
		$tid = \Cardz3n_Gateway\Token_Service::save_card_token( $uid, $gid, 'V-SAVED', array( 'last4' => '1111', 'exp_month' => '12', 'exp_year' => '2030', 'brand' => 'visa', 'initial_txn_id' => 'TX-SAVED' ) );
		$_POST = array( 'wc-cardz3n_gateway-payment-token' => (string) $tid, 'cardz3n_payment_source' => 'card' );
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $s->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'sub' => $meta( $s ), 'parent' => $meta( $p ) );
	} );
	// D3b) A saved card that has no first transaction ID: the old card's ID must not stay on the subscription.
	$run( 'change_saved_card_no_txn', function () use ( $gw, $mk_owned, $meta, $uid, $gid ) {
		list( $p, $s ) = $mk_owned();
		$tid = \Cardz3n_Gateway\Token_Service::save_card_token( $uid, $gid, 'V-SAVED2', array( 'last4' => '4242', 'exp_month' => '12', 'exp_year' => '2030', 'brand' => 'visa' ) );
		$_POST = array( 'wc-cardz3n_gateway-payment-token' => (string) $tid, 'cardz3n_payment_source' => 'card' );
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $s->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'sub' => $meta( $s ) );
	} );
	// D4) Bank (ACH) is refused.
	$run( 'change_ach_refused', function () use ( $gw, $mk_owned, $post, $meta ) {
		list( $p, $s ) = $mk_owned();
		$post( 'ach' );
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $s->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'sub' => $meta( $s ) );
	} );
	// D5) A subscription that belongs to somebody else cannot be changed.
	$run( 'change_other_customers_subscription', function () use ( $gw, $mk_owned, $post, $meta, $other_uid ) {
		list( $p, $s ) = $mk_owned( $other_uid );
		$post();
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $s->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'sub' => $meta( $s ) );
	} );
	// D6) The admin payment-meta table.
	$run( 'payment_meta_filter', function () use ( $mk_owned ) {
		list( $p, $s ) = $mk_owned();
		$pm = apply_filters( 'woocommerce_subscription_payment_meta', array( 'other_gateway' => array( 'post_meta' => array() ) ), $s );
		return array( 'meta' => $pm );
	} );
	// D7) The admin validation: an empty or odd vault ID is refused with a message.
	$run( 'payment_meta_validation', function () use ( $mk_owned, $gid ) {
		list( $p, $s ) = $mk_owned();
		$try = function ( $vault, $initial = '' ) use ( $s, $gid ) {
			$pm = array( 'post_meta' => array( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id' => array( 'value' => $vault ), '_cardz3n_initial_txn_id' => array( 'value' => $initial ) ) );
			try { do_action( 'woocommerce_subscription_validate_payment_meta_' . $gid, $pm, $s ); return 'ok'; } catch ( \Exception $e ) { return $e->getMessage(); }
		};
		return array( 'empty' => $try( '' ), 'spaces_only' => $try( '   ' ), 'odd' => $try( 'V 1;DROP' ), 'valid' => $try( 'V-123' ), 'odd_initial' => $try( 'V-123', 'TX 1;' ), 'valid_with_initial' => $try( '9876543', 'TX-55' ) );
	} );
	// D8) My Account > Payment methods > Add: verified for 0.00 and saved, never a sale.
	$run( 'add_payment_method_ok', function () use ( $gw, $post, $ntok ) {
		$before = $ntok();
		$post();
		$r = $gw->add_payment_method();
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'redirect' => $r['redirect'] ?? '', 'tokens_added' => $ntok() - $before );
	} );
	$run( 'add_payment_method_declined', function () use ( $gw, $post, $ntok ) {
		$before = $ntok();
		$post( 'card', 'tok-decline' );
		$r = $gw->add_payment_method();
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'tokens_added' => $ntok() - $before );
	} );
	$run( 'add_payment_method_ach_or_empty', function () use ( $gw, $post, $ntok ) {
		$before = $ntok();
		$post( 'ach' );
		$a = $gw->add_payment_method();
		$_POST = array();
		$b = $gw->add_payment_method();
		return array( 'ach' => $a['result'], 'empty' => $b['result'], 'tokens_added' => $ntok() - $before );
	} );
	// D9) A customer fixes a failing renewal by changing the method: the failed renewal gets the new card (either argument order).
	$run( 'failing_renewal_updated', function () use ( $mk_owned, $mk_renewal, $meta, $gid ) {
		list( $p, $s ) = $mk_owned();
		$s->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id', 'V-NEW' ); $s->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_initial_txn_id', 'TX-NEW' ); $s->save();
		$r1 = $mk_renewal( $s ); $r1->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id', 'V-OLD' ); $r1->save();
		do_action( 'woocommerce_subscription_failing_payment_method_updated_' . $gid, $s, $r1 );
		$r2 = $mk_renewal( $s ); $r2->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id', 'V-OLD' ); $r2->save();
		do_action( 'woocommerce_subscription_failing_payment_method_updated_' . $gid, $r2, $s );
		return array( 'renewal_a' => $meta( $r1 ), 'renewal_b' => $meta( $r2 ), 'sub' => $meta( $s ) );
	} );
	// D10) A normal (non-subscription) order is untouched: still a sale.
	$run( 'normal_order_still_sale', function () use ( $gw, $order, $post ) {
		$o = $order(); $post();
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'] );
	} );

	echo wp_json_encode( $out );
	exit;
}, 20 );
